item.title: Houthi forces claim six attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities
item.description: The announcement comes despite talks between Iran and the Mecca pact countries in Tehran earlier this week.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC says four tankers struck mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's IRGC says four tankers have struck naval mines after using "unauthorised" Strait of Hormuz routes.

item.title: Pentagon fires general it says leaked classified information to media
item.description: Army Lieutenant General Brett Sylvia was subject of investigation into leaking information about Iran and Ukraine.

item.title: At least 14 people killed in attack on Ukraine train station
item.description: A Russian drone strike killed at least 14 people at Dnipro’s main railway station in central Ukraine.

item.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
item.description: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

item.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
item.description: With more than 90% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.
